propositions: AGENTS.md Module-size policy section documents the 800-LOC gate but does not mention the C901 cyclomatic-complexity shrink-only ratchet that also blocks CI

The C901 ratchet enforced by scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py and configured in .github/complexity-baseline.json (threshold 15, McCabe max-complexity) fails when functions gain new debt or exceed per-symbol ceilings
Routine changes like adding CLI flags or guard clauses predictably trigger C901 failures at pre-flight, forcing unplanned extraction work
AGENTS.md must document the C901 ratchet alongside module-size limit, including gate command, baseline file, threshold source, and behavior-preserving extraction remedy
Documentation must clarify the ratchet is shrink-only (never bump baseline), runs under make lint, and provide a census command (ruff check --select C901)
